name: io.github.Panelica/panelica-mcp
description: Manage a Panelica hosting panel in plain English - 404 scoped, HMAC-signed tools.

environmentVariables.name: PANELICA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: External API base URL of your panel, e.g. https://panel.example.com:8443/api/external

environmentVariables.name: PANELICA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from the panel (Developer -> API). Grant only the scopes the assistant needs.

environmentVariables.name: PANELICA_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: API secret paired with the key; used locally for HMAC-SHA256 request signing.
